timeline.evidenceText: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”
The foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid in the fourth year, in the month Ziv.
The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.

In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house. The length by cubits* A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters. after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.
In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
From the first day of the seventh month, they began to offer burnt offerings to Yahweh; but the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was not yet laid.

When the builders laid the foundation of Yahweh’s temple, they set the priests in their clothing with trumpets, with the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise Yahweh, according to the directions of David king of Israel.

They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.

But many of the priests and Levites and heads of fathers’ households, the old men who had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice. Many also shouted aloud for joy,
In accordance with the law, the drinking was not compulsory; for so the king had instructed all the officials of his house, that they should do according to every man’s pleasure.

definitions.full: H3245. yasad יָסַד verb establish, found, fix (Late Hebrew id. , especially Pi`el; Aramaic יְסַד ; perhaps originally fix firm or close ; Arabic pillow ; verb denominative II. fix as a pillow against one ; see lean against, recline , Lane 2940 Saad Gen 28:11 ; in Hebrew usually fix firm so as to found ) — Qal Perfect יָסַד Psa 104:5 ; Prov 3:19 ; suffix יְסָדָהּ Psa 24:2-3 t.; 3 feminine singular יָסְדָה Isa 48:13 ; יָסַדְתָּ Psa 104:8 ; יָסַ֑֫דְתָּ 102:26 ; suffix יְסַדְתּוֺ Hab 1:12 ; יְסַדְתָּם Psa 89:12 ; 119:152 ; וִיסַדְתִּיךְ consecutive Isa 54:11 ; Infinitive וִיסוֺד 2Chr 24:27 ; לִיסּוֺד 31:7 (see Ges § 69 , 2, R. 1; Baer לְיִסּוֺד ); לִיסֹד Isa 51:16 ; יָסְדִי Job 38:4 ; יָסְדוֺ Ezra 3:12 ; Participle יִסֵד Isa 51:13 ; Zech 12:1 + Isa 28:16 (Che critical note , יִסַּד ᵑ0 ); — found, establish , with accusative, the earth Psa 24:2 (|| כונן ), compare 78:69 (object omitted), 89:12 ; 102:26 ; 104:5 compare 89:8 (followed by לְ ), Prov 3:19 ; Isa 48:13 ; Job 38:4 ; Isa 51:13 , 16 ; Zech 12:1 , vault of heaven Amos 9:6 ; of founding the second temple Ezra 3:12 , of restoration under Joash, Infinitive יְסוֺד 2Chr 24:27 ; metaphor of future Israel Isa 54:11 ; of ׳י , establish the Chaldaean (as his instrument) להוכיח for correction Hab 1:12 (|| שִׁים ), his commandments Psa 119:152 ; in weakened sense (si vera lectio) לְצִיִּים יָסַד Isa 23:13 appoint a city for desert-creatures (on meaning in context, see Di); appoint, fix Ezra 7:9 emended (see יְסֻד ); found, begin , heaps of offerings in ׳י s house 2Chr 31:7 . Niph`al Perfect 3plural נוֺסְְדוּ Psa 2:2 ; Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּוָּסֵד Isa 44:28 ; Infinitive הִוָּסְדָהּ Exod 9:18 ; הִיָּסְדָם Psa 31:14 ; — 1 fix or seat themselves close together sit in conclave Psa 2:2 ; 31:14 ( > Bae from , δμιλιἀ ), but Lag's emendation נוֺעֲדוּ is probably (compare Neh 6:2 ). 2 be founded , Isa 44:28 (temple), Exod 9:18 (Egypt). Pi`el Perfect יִסַּד Isa 14:32 3 t.; יִסְּדָהּ 1Kin 16:34 ; יִסַּ֫דְתָּ Psa 8:3 ; יִסְּדוּ Zech 4:9 ; Ezra 3:10 ; Imperfect יְיַסְּדֶנָּה Josh 6:26 ; Infinitive לְיַסֵּד 1 Kings 5:31; — 1 found (= Qal ), followed by active, city Josh 6:26 (JE), 1Kin 16:34 , temple 1 Kings 5:31; Zech 4:9 ; Ezra 3:10 ; Zion Isa 14:32 ; 28:16 יִסַּד הִנְנִי (read יֹסֵד ; see above) 2 establish Psa 8:3 followed by עֹז ; appoint, ordain (late) 1Chr 9:22 (followed by accusative), Est 1:8 (absolute) Pu`al Perfect , יֻסַּד 1Kin 6:37 2 t.; יֻסָּ֑ד Ezra 3:6 Participle מְיסָֻּ֑ד 1Kin 7:10 ; מְיסָֻּדִים Song 5:15 ; be founded, be laid, of a foundation 1Kin 6:37 ; Ezra 3:6 ; Hag 2:18 ; Zech 8:9 ; Participle = substantive foundation 1Kin 7:10 , compare מוסד below; pillars set on bases, simile of legs Song 5:15 . Hoph`al be founded: Infinitive הוּסַד 2Chr 3:3 ; Ezra 3:11 ; Participle מוּסָּד Isa 28:16 ; — the being founded, founding , י בֵּית הוּסַד ׳עַל Ezra 3:11 because of the founding (laying the foundation) of the house of ׳י ; וגו לִבְנוֺת שְׁלֹמֹה ׳הוּסַד וְאֵלֶּה 2Chr 3:3 and this is (literally these are) the founding of Solomon to build the house of God, i.e. this is the foundation which Solomon laid for building , etc.; Participle מוּסָּד מוּסָד Isa 28:16 a foundation founded , i.e. well laid (compare מְחֻכָּם חָכָם מְחֻמָּשׂ, חֵפֶשׂ ).
